spatial_and_orientation_analysis: Reference and delivered image both show a bed, shelving behind it, a bedside table and lamp, foreground chair and wall art. The delivered render shows a wider, more elevated cutaway view: bed and shelving occupy less of the frame, walls and floor edges are exposed, and the right foreground wall obscures the right lamp/door region rather than reproducing the reference composition. Evidence: supplied reference image and executions/blender_1795841584889935246/artifacts/final.png; final_source/build.py:21-28,31-55,66-81.

The bed has a definite long axis and headboard at its left end; the chair has a back and separate seat, but its facing and visible silhouette differ from the reference. Camera, object depth, size and orientation are confounded, so no aligned 3D error is inferred: final_source/build.py:31-42,66-74,81; reference and delivered image.

The door is a dark rectangular mesh placed alongside an uncut right wall, not a demonstrated articulated door and jamb; the reference door is cropped and its hinge and swing are uncertain: final_source/build.py:21,75-77; original_inspection/capture/original/object_inventory.jsonl:34,212; reference image.
appearance_and_resource_analysis: Reference has patterned mattress sides, prominent tabletop streaks and bright localized lamp pools. The delivered image reads smoother and more evenly lit, with simplified art and table marks; differences are confounded by composition, illumination and resolution: reference image; executions/blender_1795841584889935246/artifacts/final.png; final_source/build.py:35-39,43-65,79-83.

The source mat function sets Principled BSDF base color, roughness and metallic, and assigns materials directly to objects; it does not build an image texture, texture coordinate, mapping or procedural noise graph. Table grain is geometry, not mapped_stone. No external image or packed texture is required by this source; the independent source-only inspection reports no missing external images: final_source/build.py:6-14,43-49; independent_evaluation/source_only/reproduction.json:25-32. Standard node output connections are not independently audited here.

The artwork print is a modeled object with individually modeled marks, not evidence of a full-reference image-plane shortcut: final_source/build.py:56-65; original_inspection/capture/original/object_inventory.jsonl:120-122.
geometry_analysis: The shelf is built as five columns by four rows of separate boards, the mattress as a beveled block with stitch cylinders, and the chair as a beveled seat, subdivided solidified back and four legs: final_source/build.py:23-28,35-39,66-74. Reference silhouette and fine surface detail differ; physical contact or collision clearance is not established.

The student scene inventory gives bed feet bottoms at approximately z=0.03 while the floor top is z=0, but rug and local supports complicate interpretation; this is not a mesh-level contact test: original_inspection/capture/original/object_inventory.jsonl:1,48-53. Evaluator AABB candidates are broad-phase only, not confirmed penetrations: independent_evaluation/source_only/reproduction.json:25-40.
